note: The owner's goal: traffic from people looking for the best and famous clubs in Berlin. 'best' ~5,360 and 'famous' ~3,770 global across their variants, US only 10-15%. The 'famous' queries have Berghain as their parent topic, so the page answers 'Berghain' in its first sentence instead of chasing the brand. 'legendary', 'iconic', 'oldest' and 'history' return nothing at 20+ a month: the word is in the title, not the map. The weakest editorial pages in the best and famous SERPs hold 0-2 referring domains (questoapp, tv-turm, trip.com), and a list page with 2 RD ranks 6-12 across 22 of these queries, which is the realistic ceiling without links.
